collection.title: Bentley Continental Convertible 1984 to 1994 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Bentley Continental 1984 - 1995 model which requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 22" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
